text:
For an outage lasting roughly a day, I’d look at the **[BLUETTI Elite 200 V2](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2)**. The source lists a 2,073.6 Wh battery and estimates about a day for a 100 W ceramic heat emitter when it’s controlled by a thermostat; that’s an estimate, not a guaranteed runtime. It lists the station at $899, with a discount code applied through the buy link. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/power-station-to-keep-reptile-heat-on-in-a-power-outage))

A **heat mat generally draws much less power than a lamp**, so it can last longer on a station—but check your actual heater’s wattage and how often the thermostat will run it before buying. Insulate the enclosure to hold heat, and keep using a thermostat to control the heater. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/power-station-to-keep-reptile-heat-on-in-a-power-outage); [Petco outage guidance](https://www.petco.com/pet-education/reptile/general/caring-for-your-pet-reptiles-during-a-power-outage))
